## Project summary

This project treats a screenshot archive as evidence rather than as a finished archive of final content. The work focuses on reconstruction, verification, and planning so that the future site can be rebuilt accurately without preserving stale or misleading material.

### Key deliverables

- [Recovery and remediation memo](docs/audit/memo.qmd)
- [Reconstructed sitemap](docs/audit/sitemap.qmd)
- [Content inventory](docs/audit/inventory.qmd)
- [Text recovery workflow](docs/audit/recovery-workflow.qmd)

### Evidence generated

- SQLite inventory database and CSV export
- sample OCR and verified text files
- OCR error log and recovery notes
- sitemap source and rendered PNG

### Why this matters

The archive is useful for understanding the site’s shape and page types, but it is not a replacement for a complete final content source. The archive can support a careful rebuild only if recovery and verification are treated as separate steps from remediation.
